preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 10^4.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and isinstance(k, int) and 1 <= k < n <= 200000 for n, k in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, n (rooms) and k (friends) are integers satisfying 1 <= k < n <= 2*10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(len(friends) == k and all(2 <= x <= n for x in friends) and len(set(friends)) == k for friends in friend_lists)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the list of friend positions has length k, all positions are between 2 and n, and all positions are distinct.

preconditions.expression: all(len(edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges) for n, edges in zip(ns, edge_lists))
preconditions.description: For each test case, there are exactly n-1 edges, and each edge connects two valid room numbers between 1 and n.
The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 2*10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(is_tree(n, edges) for n, edges in zip(ns, edge_lists))
preconditions.description: The graph formed by rooms and corridors is a connected tree (undirected, n nodes, n-1 edges).

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(line.strip().upper() == 'YES' or line.strip().upper() == 'NO' for line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is either 'YES' or 'NO' (case-insensitive).

postconditions.expression: all((line.strip().upper() == 'YES') == can_vlad_win(n, k, friends, edges) for line, (n, k, friends, edges) in zip(stdout_lines, test_cases))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is 'YES' if and only if there exists a leaf node L (degree 1, L != 1) such that the distance from room 1 to L is strictly less than the distance from any friend's starting position to L.
